tool_args.rationale: The high-s_grad probe confirmed a sharp downturn and sign change, but the failed fits do not establish whether the response is static or memory-driven. A fine trajectory batch is the relevant available measurement to test and identify coupled-memory dynamics before choosing another model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a third stationary fit, such as a generic gradient-interaction law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Three fitted stationary candidates have been refuted on fresh confirmation; the current measurements hold H, x_now, and mem_conv fixed, so temporal/memory mechanisms remain untested.
There is no reported high-frequency chaotic sign oscillation, and the available evidence does not rule out stationary mechanisms.
An auxiliary nuisance measurement would not resolve the unresolved temporal/memory behavior.
